jcr:title: ED Prevention is IN: Reducing Falls and Saving Skin Pro

eventdetail.eventDetail: As more and more patients enter the hospital through the ED, emergency nurses are not only tasked with saving lives in emergencies – but they’re also responsible for keeping patients safe from adverse outcomes such as pressure injuries and falls. During our free webinar, “ED Prevention is IN: Reducing Falls and Saving Skin,” our clinical nurse consultant, Chantelle Hicks, will offer insights into how you can prevent falls and save skin – helping to ensure a patient’s care starts and ends in the ED. She will also share eye-opening statistics, discuss the human and financial costs of pressure injuries and falls, identify risk factors and interventions, and more – providing you with a holistic overview of why prevention is essential in the ED.
